title: The Toynbee Tiles: Messages Hidden in City Streets
description: Since the 1980s, mysterious plaques bearing cryptic messages have appeared embedded in asphalt in several cities, mostly in the United States and South America. Their creator and meaning remain debated.

scenes.narration: For decades, strange messages have appeared embedded directly into city streets.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a weathered rectangular message tile embedded in an urban asphalt road, pavement texture, documentary photography, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no watermark

scenes.narration: The plaques became known as Toynbee Tiles, after a recurring reference to historian Arnold Toynbee.
scenes.image_prompt: Urban street intersection with a small cryptic pavement plaque, pedestrians walking past, realistic city documentary scene, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no watermark

scenes.narration: Their unusual message describes bringing the dead back to life on the planet Jupiter.

scenes.narration: Similar tiles were reported in cities across the United States and South America, often disappearing as roads were repaired.

scenes.narration: The mystery inspired years of searching for the maker, with investigations pointing toward possible individuals but leaving debate.
